Use the Build a Report and Build a Dashboard tiles to create new content:

  • Report Builder — pick a primary object, add related objects, choose fields, set filters, then save into a folder. Filter and column changes are previewed live.
  • Dashboard Builder — compose a multi-component layout with KPI tiles, charts, and tables. Each component is bound to a saved report.
  • Sharing — set the report or dashboard to Public to share with anyone who has the Vital Reports User perm set, or use Folder ownership for tighter control.

Standard users on the Vital Reports User perm set can also build reports today — if you want viewer-only access, contact your admin about a slimmer perm-set assignment.
